**How to keep ads from delivering spyware: good, better, best.**

Citizen Lab traced Candiru spyware on Al Jazeera devices back to targeted ads.

Per the report, a device could be infected **the moment the ad rendered.**

All three rungs come from the report's own recommendations.

**Which rung are you on? Save this.**
bullets: Good: an ad blocker in every browser. Easy, but apps still show ads.
Better: turn off the mobile ad ID, via MDM at work. Ads still load, less targeted.
Best: block ads at the gateway or router. Covers apps, not phones off that network.
